events.head: Probe the app URLs and check how pass.py sets blockers
events.input: $ for u in https://usetantra.com https://usetantra.com/connectors/channels/linkedin https://usetantra.com/campaigns; do curl -s -o /dev/null -m 20 -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url} $u\n" $u; done; git status --short workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/ | head -3; grep -n "blockers" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -8
